correctness.rationale: The theorem uses all interior-peak-position profiles with multiplicity and the unnormalized Walsh transform. For prescribed peaks, an adjacent pair makes the event impossible, and maximal chains of peaks two apart force alternating patterns on disjoint windows of independent continuous ranks. Their probabilities are products of E_(2r+1)/(2r+1)!. The tangent differential recurrence divides only by 2r+1, so each probability is in Z_(2). Expanding the character product leaves 1 modulo 2 in Z_(2) after dividing by n!. This proves the exact valuation and rank, including the singleton groups at n=1,2. The sum of all Walsh multipliers is 2^|I_n| f_n(empty)=2^(|I_n|+n-1), since a peak-free permutation decreases up to 1 and then increases. Hence the common gcd has no odd prime factor and has the asserted dyadic part; this does not claim an attained minimum multiplier magnitude. The uploaded checker was inspected, not executed. A separate direct permutation enumeration and integer Walsh transform checked every frequency and the gcd for n=1 through 9; replay: /workspace/branches/cb983fd9-85ae-459d-a9c4-09bca3f58c25/direct_peak_replay.py and direct_replay_n1_9.log in that directory. This is finite corroboration only.
